vendor: Scite, LLC (a subsidiary of Research Solutions, Inc.)
product_family: AI research assistant for scientific literature (Smart Citations, full-text search across 280M+ articles, Scite Assistant Q&A, Reference Check, Collections); available as web app, API, and MCP server for Claude/ChatGPT/other MCP-compatible tools

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type I or II)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on scite.ai, scite.ai/policy, or scite.ai/terms. No trust center exists at trust.scite.ai (page does not resolve) or on parent company researchsolutions.com. A third-party aggregator (search result summarizing a Nudge Security auto-generated profile) claims scite.ai is 'SOC 2 Compliant, PCI Compliant, HIPAA Compliant, GDPR Compliant, ISO 27001 Compliant, FedRamp Compliant, and CSA Star Level 1 Compliant' but this is an unverifiable third-party inference with no vendor-domain source and is not corroborated anywhere on scite.ai or researchsolutions.com. Treated as an over-claim, not evidence.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on any scite.ai page. Not mentioned in Privacy Policy or Terms of Service. See SOC 2 note above regarding the unverifiable third-party aggregator claim.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on any scite.ai page. Scite is a scholarly-literature research tool, not a covered entity or business-associate product; no BAA or HIPAA language found anywhere on the site.

certifications.name: GDPR (compliance posture, not a certification)
certifications.proof_quote: Scite will comply with its privacy policy and applicable privacy laws and regulations including the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) with respect to personal data within Scite's possession and control ... we implement the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission for cross-border data transfers.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on any scite.ai page. Payment processing is not described in detail in the Privacy Policy beyond 'we collect payment details to provide services'; no PCI DSS attestation referenced.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on any scite.ai page. Scite is a consumer/academic/enterprise research tool with no government-authorization marketing; FedRAMP is implausible for a company of this profile and unsupported by any vendor-domain source.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on any scite.ai page.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management system)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on any scite.ai page. No AI-governance certification referenced.

privacy.ai_training_note: Terms of Service state explicitly: 'the Company does not use Customer Data ... to train, fine-tune, or improve such AI systems' and 'this license does not include any right to use Customer Data (including Media) for the training, fine-tuning, retraining, or improvement of large language models.' No separate stand-alone DPA document was found on the vendor domain; cross-border transfer language in the Privacy Policy references standard contractual clauses rather than a downloadable DPA, so dpa is graded false pending confirmation that a signable DPA exists for paid/enterprise customers.
privacy.data_region: US-based; Privacy Policy states 'most of our operations are conducted in the United States' and that personal information will be processed there, with standard contractual clauses used for transfers of EU/UK data outside the EU.

security.name: AI training on customer data
security.value: Explicitly disclaimed in Terms of Service: customer data and user-uploaded media are not used to train, fine-tune, or improve LLMs/AI systems.

security.name: Cross-border data transfer mechanism
security.value: Standard contractual clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission, per Privacy Policy Section on EU/UK residents.

security.name: Data retention
security.value: Account data retained for as long as the account exists plus up to 10 years after; marketing data retained up to 10 years; other data retained only as long as necessary for its purpose.

security.name: Bot/abuse protection
security.value: Site protected by reCAPTCHA (Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply), per homepage footer.

security.name: Dedicated security page / trust center
security.value: None found. No trust.scite.ai, no /security page discoverable via site search, and no trust center on parent company researchsolutions.com.

products.name: Scite (Free)
products.data_scope: Search and limited Smart Citations access; account data per standard Privacy Policy.

products.name: Scite Personal/Pro
products.data_scope: Full Smart Citations, Scite Assistant Q&A, unlimited search; same privacy/AI-training terms apply.
products.notes: $20-29/user/month range per third-party pricing summaries (not independently confirmed on vendor pricing page in this pass).

products.name: Scite Organization/Enterprise
products.data_scope: Institution-wide access with SSO, analytics, dedicated support; sold via sales@scite.ai.
products.notes: No enterprise-specific security addendum, DPA, or trust center was located publicly; institutional buyers should request one directly from sales.

products.name: Scite API / Developer
products.data_scope: Programmatic access to Smart Citations and literature data for integration into third-party tools.

products.name: Scite MCP
products.data_scope: Exposes Scite's search/citation data to MCP-compatible AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code); requires an underlying Scite subscription.
products.notes: Query data flows through the same backend and Privacy Policy/Terms as the web product; no separate MCP-specific privacy terms found.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: free tier, paid individual tier (~$20-29/user/month per third-party pricing pages), custom-quoted Organization/Enterprise and Developer/API tiers via sales@scite.ai
compare.data_residency: United States (primary operations); SCCs used for EU/UK personal data transfers

flags: No trust center found on scite.ai or parent company researchsolutions.com; security posture is inferred only from the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service, not a dedicated security disclosure.

A third-party aggregator (via search result summarizing a Nudge Security-style profile) claims scite.ai holds SOC 2, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR certifications. None of these are corroborated on any scite.ai or researchsolutions.com page. This looks like an automated/unverified vendor-database claim and should NOT be surfaced on AIFOXX as a confirmed cert; flagging as a probable over-claim risk.

No stand-alone Data Processing Agreement (DPA) document was locatable on the vendor domain; enterprise/institutional customers should confirm DPA availability directly with Scite sales before assuming GDPR Art. 28 coverage.

Identity note: Scite, LLC is a subsidiary of Research Solutions, Inc. (public company, ticker RSSS/OTCQB per search results); no evidence that Research Solutions' own compliance posture (if any exists) extends to Scite as a distinct product, so certs were graded on Scite's own domain only.
Recommend a follow-up live check before publishing if higher certainty is required.
